name: @sde-code/eslint-plugin-layers
description: Custom ESLint rule that enforces the one-directional layer dependency order (kernel < platform < editor < extension-host < workbench < host) inside apps/desktop/src, the way VS Code's own local/code-import-patterns rule enforces its base/platform/editor/workbench stack. Original implementation, not copied from VS Code's eslint plugin.
